summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend regression: 46/46 pytest tests PASS. All new features verified: offline idempotency (client_id) on receptions/temperatures/cleaning/non-conformities/losses returns identical record on double POST; GET /api/statistics returns weeks/months/receptions/losses/nc/temperatures per-period + temperature_conformity + dlc_stats + totals; GET & PUT /api/reminders/config (defaults 08:00/18:00 + 20:00; employe -> 403); GET /api/reminders/pending computes uncompleted controls; /api/dashboard now includes pending_controls; CSV export for 5 doc_types + lot history with UTF-8 BOM and ';' delimiter; invalid CSV type -> 400. Strict company isolation confirmed with 2 fresh orgs (list, csv, batches, statistics, reminders all scoped by org_id; same client_id across orgs is allowed and namespaced). Existing MVP suite (auth, receptions, batches, temperatures, cleaning, NC+PATCH, losses, search, archives, PDF, users, subscribe/cancel, file upload) is still fully green. Frontend UI validated on mobile viewport (390x844): login -> dashboard (sync banner 'EN LIGNE', 'Contrôles à effectuer' section, Statistiques action button, all KPI tiles), /statistics renders totals + period toggle + bar/pie charts, /reminders manager can toggle temperature times/cleaning + save (confirmation 'Enregistré ✓' shown), archives screen shows 'EXPORTER CSV' + 'FILTRES' panel. No red screen errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (already reported iteration 1; still present). Non-blocking, but should be migrated. Likely coming from a library (react-native-gesture-handler / react-native-svg / gifted-charts) rather than app code.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents where possible; if it comes from a 3rd-party lib, bump versions.
(Optional) server.py is 1106 lines -> consider splitting into routers (auth, receptions, statistics, reminders, csv) for maintainability; non-blocking.
(Optional, from iter-2) surface a 'cancel_at_period_end' / 'canceled_on_trial' sub-state on /subscription so UI can show 'annulé - accès jusqu'au JJ/MM/AAAA' while trial is still active.
critical_code_review_comments: create_doc() correctly scopes idempotency by (id, org_id) so client_id collisions across orgs are safe (verified in TestCompanyIsolation).

CSV export uses regex $regex user input directly (product/batch/supplier). Values are already scoped by org_id, but consider re.escape() on user-supplied regex to avoid accidental regex-injection / catastrophic backtracking on malformed input.

compute_pending_controls uses count_documents on created_at >= today_start (UTC). If servers are in another TZ, 'today' boundary may not match user's local day; acceptable for MVP but worth flagging for FR customers on DST edges.
statistics() loads up to 5000 docs per collection into memory — fine for MVP but should be aggregated in Mongo ($group by isoWeek/month) once orgs grow.
Frontend: statistics.tsx has 'import { useEffect }' unused; reminders.tsx imports 'Divider' unused. Cosmetic.
